environment.grade: neither A nor B (EVALUATION 4.4 names Windows 11 machines): the values here are references, not a verdict

provider.meaning: a test double answers every extraction with one fixed, schema-valid knowledge line quoting the document; call counts and extraction times are the stub's, not a real model's

judgement: none: thresholds are EVALUATION 4.4's, copied beside each value; they are judged only on grade A hardware with corpus T2 and a real Provider (D2)

installerSize.reason: no installer is built in this run

idleCpu.note: observed 30 s; EVALUATION asks for a 10-minute idle, so this is shorter than the reference; the sample is CPU time over wall time across all logical cores

idleRss.note: observed 30 s; EVALUATION asks for a 10-minute idle, so this is shorter than the reference; the embedding model is not loaded in this run

processingSearchable.definition: from sending the document to the import API until a keyword search returns it

threshold.label: 신규 문서 처리(검색 가능까지, LLM 제외)

processingExtracted.definition: from sending the document until every job is done (the stub answers after the stated delay); documents are sent one at a time, so no queue wait is in it

threshold.label: 신규 문서 처리(지식 추출까지, LLM 포함)

search.definition: one keyword-search request over HTTP, timed only when the query's own document is in the results

maxPerDoc.reason: the call history carries no document number (D8)

perQaQuestion.reason: Q&A needs an answer double of its own (D8)

daily.reason: no day of use was run (D8)

storage.definition: (data folder bytes - raw text bytes) / raw text bytes at the last point; raw and derived data share one SQLite file, so the folder stands for the derived data (D7)

killRecover.note: firstJobAfterRestartMs is the time from the restart to the first job to run (any job); allJobsDoneMs to every job finished, the interrupted job included, which waits for its lease to run out

threshold.label: 강제 종료 후 복구
threshold.text: 재시작 후 ≤ 60 s에 작업 재개, 유실 0건, 중복 지식 항목 0건 (하드)

soak.reason: soak seconds is 0 (the default): a soak is run on request (--soak-seconds)
